lastCompletedStory.title: Transcript-usage golden fixture + replay against usage parsers

nextStoryContext: US-002 added test/fixtures/golden/transcript-usage.jsonl: a committed, real-shaped 6-line transcript fragment (1 degenerate no-id/no-requestId line for the fallback-key branch, 3 content-block lines sharing one (message.id,requestId) pair, 2 content-block lines sharing a second later pair). No new test file was needed: the replay describe block lives inside the existing test/transcript/usage.test.ts (which already covers parseTranscriptUsage/parseContextOccupancy end-to-end), using a local readGoldenFixture helper mirroring US-001's convention. Consolidation: deleted the two hand-inlined tests whose sole purpose (multi-block-turn dedup demonstration for cumulative totals, and for last-request occupancy) is now covered by the golden-fixture replay; kept every other hand-inlined edge case (empty/malformed input, missing optional sub-fields, distinct-pair independence, fallback-key uniqueness, interspersed last-wins ordering, cumulative-vs-occupancy divergence) since the single fixture does not cover those. US-003 (self-authored-artifact-shape fixtures, likely worker-report.json / handoff.json shape replay) should follow the same convention: grep patterns.md for 'Golden-fixture' bullets before designing its own fixture, and prefer extending an existing test file's describe block over creating a new test file when the module under test already has one.
